theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (F : Set α) (a : ℝ) (u : α → ℝ), MeasurableSet F → 0 < a → μ F = ENNReal.ofReal a → Measurable u → IntegrableOn u F μ → ∫⁻ x in F, ENNReal.ofReal |u x - a⁻¹ * ∫ y in F, u y ∂μ| ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a⁻¹ * ∫⁻ x in F, ∫⁻ y in F, ENNReal.ofReal |u x - u y| ∂μ ∂μ
